appearance_facts.fact: A single solid orange line with four circular markers rises steadily from the lower-left to the upper-right, with no visible dip or plateau.
The 2017 marker is the lowest point on the line; the 2018 and 2019 markers sit progressively higher; the 2020 marker is the highest point on the line.
The line spans the full horizontal width of the plot area, connecting the 2017 marker to the 2020 marker.

printed_facts.fact: Title: 'Hospital Screening Referral Volume'; subtitle: 'Reported window shown in the dashboard summary'.
2017 marker is just above the 100 tick; 2018 marker is just below the 120 tick; 2019 marker is just below the 135 level (between 130 and 140); 2020 marker is at the 150 tick.

public_definitions: Task: 'Review the referral dashboard and assign the record to the follow-up pathway that best fits the full 2013-2020 utilization pattern.'

Scope: 'Use the displayed referral history for the entire reporting window to determine whether this record reflects sustained period-wide growth, a more recent increase that should remain under monitoring, or a broader downward pattern requiring review.'
Option A: 'Assign to continued monitoring for a recent upward shift that warrants observation'
Option B: 'Assign to sustained-growth follow-up for a period-wide increase in referrals'
Option C: 'Assign to decline review for a downward referral pattern'
uncertain: The displayed chart only shows years 2017-2020, while the task and 'Review window' field reference a 2013-2020 pattern; the 2013-2016 segment is not visible on the chart, so its trajectory cannot be confirmed from the image.
